dedupe_keys.name: the internet exchange point toolkit and best practices guide internet society february 2014

description: The Internet Society's IXP Toolkit and Best Practices Guide (February 2014 collaborative draft, 92 pages) explains how to maximise the effectiveness of independent network interconnection in developing regions and emerging markets. Chapters cover the role of IXPs and patterns of distribution and membership, institutional and operational models (for-profit carrier-neutral, non-profit member-owned, and sponsored IXPs), getting started and best practices, the economics of IXPs, a benchmarking methodology for assessing performance, and case studies and IXP facts by country across Africa, Asia, Latin America, the Caribbean, the Pacific and Europe. Producer: the Internet Society, with funding from Google. Coverage: global, with country case studies. Access: free PDF on the Internet Society site. Licence and cost: free; the title page states CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported. Caveats: data date from 2013 and early 2014, and it is a collaborative draft. Simulation uses: the benchmarking methodology and cost and traffic figures give parameters for capacity-planning and interconnection models. Related records: the ISOC IXP success stories collection (case_study-isoc-ixp-success-stories-collection) and the PCH IXP directory (data-pch-ixp-directory).
